prompt: /deep-research I'm analysing the baskets of goods and services used to measure consumer price inflation by the Office of National Statistics. On the ONS website, in the tables showing the allocation of items to 'Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs' (CPIH) divisions for 2020-2024 (inclusive), which categories, if any, experienced fluctuations in figures of representative items (per cent of total) over the course of this period? List the categories in alphabetical order, separated by a comma and a space.
instruction: I'm analysing the baskets of goods and services used to measure consumer price inflation by the Office of National Statistics. On the ONS website, in the tables showing the allocation of items to 'Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs' (CPIH) divisions for 2020-2024 (inclusive), which categories, if any, experienced fluctuations in figures of representative items (per cent of total) over the course of this period? List the categories in alphabetical order, separated by a comma and a space.
answer:
Based on my research of the ONS "Consumer price inflation basket of goods and services" articles for 2020-2024, I've extracted the "Representative items (per cent of total)" figures for each CPIH division across all five years. Here are the categories that experienced fluctuations:

**Categories with fluctuations in representative items (% of total) from 2020-2024:**

- Clothing and footwear (11% in 2020 → 12% in 2021-2024)
- Food and non-alcoholic beverages (24% in 2020-2023 → 25% in 2024)
- Housing and household services (5% in 2020-2022 → 4% in 2023-2024)
- Miscellaneous goods and services (11% in 2020, 10% in 2021, 11% in 2022, 10% in 2023-2024)
- Restaurants and hotels (7% in 2020-2022 → 6% in 2023-2024)
- Transport (6% in 2020-2022 → 7% in 2023-2024)

**Alphabetically ordered:**

Clothing and footwear, Food and non-alcoholic beverages, Housing and household services, Miscellaneous goods and services, Restaurants and hotels, Transport

**Sources:**
- 2020: [ONS Table 1 for 2020](https://www.ons.gov.uk/economy/inflationandpriceindices/articles/ukconsumerpriceinflationbasketofgoodsandservices/2020) – lines 121-133
- 2021: [ONS Table 1 for 2021](https://www.ons.gov.uk/economy/inflationandpriceindices/articles/ukconsumerpriceinflationbasketofgoodsandservices/2021) – lines 125-137
- 2022: [ONS Table 1 for 2022](https://www.ons.gov.uk/economy/inflationandpriceindices/articles/ukconsumerpriceinflationbasketofgoodsandservices/2022) – lines 121-133
- 2023: [ONS Table 1 for 2023](https://www.ons.gov.uk/economy/inflationandpriceindices/articles/ukconsumerpriceinflationbasketofgoodsandservices/2023) – lines 167-180
- 2024: [ONS Table 1 for 2024](https://www.ons.gov.uk/economy/inflationandpriceindices/articles/ukconsumerpriceinflationbasketofgoodsandservices/2024) – lines 165-178
expected_answer: Clothing & footwear, Food & non-alcoholic beverages, Housing & household services, Miscellaneous goods and services, Restaurants & hotels, Transport
